subject: Vendor onboarding: CloudForge PO cadence & early-pay proposal
messages:
From: Sasha Irwin <sasha.irwin@cloudforge.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New vendor onboarding / payment terms question

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this — we’re excited to start sending usage invoices to Redwood for the managed connector work. Quick background: we need to complete your vendor onboarding and submit a PO for the initial deployment.

Two quick questions before we upload our docs:
- Does Redwood accept Net45 payment terms for new vendors, or is Net30 the default?
- We can offer an early-pay discount (1% if paid within 15 days). Would Redwood be open to that structure (Net45 with early-pay discount)?

I’ve attached our onboarding packet and W-9. If there’s a preferred PO template please send it over and we’ll route internally.

Attachments: CloudForge_onboarding_form.pdf (application), CloudForge_W-9.pdf

Best,
Sasha Irwin
Head of Finance Operations | CloudForge
accounts-payable@cloudforge.com
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Irwin <sasha.irwin@cloudforge.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-19T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding / payment terms question

Hi Sasha — welcome, and thanks for the packet. I’ve looped in David (Finance) and Marissa (Sales ops) to confirm process and PO template.

High level: our standard is Net30, but exceptions are possible for strategic partners or pilot deals. For your ask (Net45 + 1% early-pay), david can advise on whether finance will sign off or if we need a different structure (e.g., Net30 with early-pay discount).

I’ll hold the onboarding docs and proceed once finance confirms. Marissa — any commercial notes from your side (commit levels, pilot timeline) that would help the approval?

Thanks,
Olga
Vendor Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-19T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: New vendor onboarding / payment terms question

Olga / Marissa — quick finance take: our baseline vendor payment term is Net30. Exceptions are evaluated on a case-by-case basis when there is a clear cost or operational rationale. Two paths we typically consider:
1) Standard onboarding: Net30, PO issued using our template.
2) Pilot exception: Net45 for the first 90 days if vendor provides an early-pay option that benefits Redwood (we’ve approved 0.75%–1.5% discounts historically for Net15).

For CloudForge, if they can commit to an early-pay program (1% for payment within 15 days) we can consider Net45 for the pilot, subject to AP enrollment and a signed early-pay agreement. Require: completed onboarding form, W-9 (they provided), and PO template filled.

I’ll prepare the PO template and a brief early-pay agreement draft. Olga — if sales confirms expected monthly spend (approx $Xk) that strengthens the case.

-David
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-19T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding / payment terms question

Quick note from sales ops: CloudForge is scoped at ~$45k MRR for the connector pilot (Q3). Happy to treat this as a short pilot exception to accelerate deployment.

-Marissa
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Sasha Irwin <sasha.irwin@cloudforge.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts-payable@cloudforge.com
Date: 2026-07-20T08:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding / payment terms question

Hi Olga — thanks for the quick replies and for looping finance.

CloudForge is comfortable offering a 1% early-pay discount if Redwood can enroll in the program and issue Net45 for the initial 90-day pilot. We can sign a short early-pay addendum. Please send the PO template and any agreement language you need; we’ll get the PO routed immediately.

Also attaching a copy of our standard vendor remittance instructions.

Attachments referenced: vendor_remittance_instructions.pdf

Best,
Sasha
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Irwin <sasha.irwin@cloudforge.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-21T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Approval: CloudForge pilot terms & PO template

Hi Sasha — glad we could align. Finance has approved a pilot exception: Redwood will accept Net45 for the initial 90-day pilot on the following terms:
- Net45 payment term for pilot invoices
- 1.0% early-pay discount if paid within 15 days (applies per invoice)
- Enrollment in Redwood AP early-pay program (simple enrollment form)
- PO to be issued using the attached PO_template_CloudForge.xlsx and signed early_pay_agreement.docx

I’ve attached the PO template and the early-pay agreement draft. Please return a signed copy of the early-pay agreement and the PO when ready. Once received, AP will set CloudForge up in the ERP and route payments per the new cadence.

Attachments: PO_template_CloudForge.xlsx, early_pay_agreement.docx

If you want to escalate to legal for language changes, copy legal@redwood.ai and we’ll coordinate.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

-David Kim
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
